# @arki/embeddings

> Text to vectors behind one Embedder shape: checked output, every expected failure returned as a value, and embedding spaces that stop vectors from different models being mixed.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/embeddings`: text → vectors behind one `Embedder` shape. `Cancelled`, `ConfigurationFailure`, `E5_INSTRUCTION`, `EMBEDDINGGEMMA_2_INSTRUCTION`, `EMBEDDINGGEMMA_INSTRUCTION`, `GEMINI_EMBEDDING_2_INSTRUCTION`, `InputTooLong`, `InvalidOutput`, `ModelUnavailable`, `NOMIC_INSTRUCTION`, `NO_INSTRUCTION`, `QWEN3_INSTRUCTION`; and 55 more.
- `@arki/embeddings/ollama`: a local Ollama server over `fetch` (`/api/embed`, one request per chunk). `createOllamaModel`; types `OllamaModelOptions`.
- `@arki/embeddings/openai`: OpenAI embedding models through the AI SDK. `createOpenAIModel`; types `OpenAIModelOptions`.
- `@arki/embeddings/openai-compatible`: any server that speaks OpenAI's `POST /embeddings` (Nebius, TEI, vLLM, LM Studio, a proxy) over plain `fetch`. `createOpenAICompatibleModel`; types `OpenAICompatibleModelOptions`.
- `@arki/embeddings/voyage`: Voyage AI over plain `fetch` (`POST /v1/embeddings`; the multimodal models use `POST /v1/multimodalembeddings`). `createVoyageModel`, `createVoyageReranker`; types `VoyageModelOptions`, `VoyageRerankerOptions`.
- `@arki/embeddings/cohere`: Cohere over plain `fetch` (`POST /v2/embed`). `createCohereCompatibleReranker`, `createCohereModel`, `createCohereReranker`; types `CohereCompatibleRerankerOptions`, `CohereModelOptions`, `CohereRerankerOptions`.
- `@arki/embeddings/google`: Gemini embedding models. `createGoogleModel`; types `GoogleModelOptions`.
- `@arki/embeddings/mistral`: Mistral embedding models through the AI SDK. `createMistralModel`; types `MistralModelOptions`.
- `@arki/embeddings/jina`: Jina AI over plain `fetch` (`POST /v1/embeddings`). `createJinaModel`, `createJinaReranker`; types `JinaModelOptions`, `JinaRerankerOptions`.
- `@arki/embeddings/sparse`: sparse (SPLADE) vectors from a Text Embeddings Inference server's `POST /embed_sparse` over plain `fetch` (TEI started with `--pooling splade` on a BERT or DistilBERT masked-LM). `createSparseModel`, `isSameSparseSpace`, `requireSparseSpace`, `sparseSpaceId`; types `SparseBatch`, `SparseEmbedOptions`, `SparseEmbedder`, `SparseModelOptions`, `SparseSpace`, `SparseVector`.
- `@arki/embeddings/rerank`: put search hits in order of relevance to one query. `RERANK_PROVIDERS`, `rerank`, `withRerankCache`; types `RerankCacheOptions`, `RerankCallOptions`, `RerankHit`, `RerankOptions`, `RerankProviderName`, `RerankResult`, `Reranker`.
- `@arki/embeddings/tei`: a reranker on a Hugging Face Text Embeddings Inference server (`POST /rerank`, a sequence-classification model such as `BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3`). `createTeiReranker`; types `TeiRerankerOptions`.
- `@arki/embeddings/bedrock`: Amazon Titan Text Embeddings on AWS Bedrock through the AI SDK. `createBedrockModel`; types `BedrockModelOptions`.
- `@arki/embeddings/env`: validates the embedding variables with `@arki/env`. `resolveEmbeddingConfig`.
- `@arki/embeddings/testing`: a deterministic fake embedder and fake reranker for tests, and real vectors recorded once and replayed offline. `fakeEmbedder`, `fakeReranker`, `fixtureEmbedder`, `recordEmbedder`; types `FakeEmbedderOptions`, `FakeRerankerOptions`.
- `@arki/embeddings/kv`: a `CacheStore` over an `@arki/kv` client (or anything with its `get` and `set`), so `withCache` shares vectors across processes through Redis. `kvCacheStore`.
- `@arki/embeddings/dot`: the app's one embedder as a Dot unit. `embeddings`.
- `@arki/embeddings/transformers`: a model run in process by Transformers.js (ONNX Runtime), no server. `createTransformersModel`, `createTransformersReranker`; types `TransformersModelOptions`, `TransformersRerankerOptions`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite
- Check every result with `isFailure` before reading `vectors`. A failed `embedMany` has none.
- Store `spaceId(batch.space)` next to every index; a different space means re-embed.
- The embedder never changes input text (call `normalizeText` yourself), and `fakeEmbedder` is not semantic.
- Retry only through `withResilience`: it retries `RateLimited` and an unreachable model, nothing else.
- A cache key covers the space and the exact text; `embeddings()` from `./dot` publishes `null` when nothing resolves.
- `resolveEmbeddingModel` never touches the network. Cohere, Mistral and OpenAI-compatible servers resolve only when named in the ref.
- `resolveSpace(embedder)` learns Ollama's digest before stale-row checks. Int8 needs one shared `calibrateInt8` range; binary packs MSB first.
